context: Tests that design canvas and DESIGN.md work activates the frontend skill's design reference and follows its precedence.

checklist.name: finds_canvas_via_index
checklist.description: Locates the Android canvas through the put.io Notion Design canvases index rather than a guessed or repository-stored link, and keeps the canvas link out of the repository.

checklist.name: reads_before_publish
checklist.description: Reads the current canvas right before publishing the new board, and starts the board from captures of the shipped app.

checklist.name: routes_new_token
checklist.description: Sends the new warning color to @putdotio/design first and takes its value from that release; types no color value by hand into the canvas or DESIGN.md.

checklist.name: records_in_design_md
checklist.description: Records the decision in the Android repository's root DESIGN.md in the design.md format and runs its lint, without changing app code.

checklist.name: keeps_canvas_scope
checklist.description: Does not prescribe code-level frontend rules (state, effects, tests) for the canvas and contract work.
